name: Devin CLI
description: Install Devin CLI for AI-powered development and share its config folder with other agents.

version.description: Version of Devin CLI to install (e.g. 'latest' or a release tag like '2026.8.18')

installMethod.description: Install Devin via the official install script or a direct binary tarball

shareConfig.description: When true, symlink the agent's config dir to the shared AGENT_CONFIG_DIR so config persists across container rebuilds and is shared with other agents
